name: Entertainment
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize a wise and pure heart in all actions, including how they approach entertainment, as reflected in Psalms 101:2. True joy and praise are found in honoring God, not in earthly treasures or distractions that corrupt, as Matthew 6:19 and Luke 12:33 warn against. Christians are urged to be discerning and wise toward what is good while remaining harmless concerning evil, emphasizing a Christ-centered focus rather than divided loyalties, as taught in Matthew 6:24 and Romans 16:19.
